Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

import numpy as np, os, re, collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
print({k:(np.array(v).shape) for k,v in G.items()})
for n in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output']); h,w=I.shape
    cnt=collections.Counter(I.flat); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    shp=[v for v in cnt if v!=bg]
    ch=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r,c]!=O[r,c]]
    # describe changed cells: which side of the shape bbox, parity of (r+c), distance to bbox edge
    bb=(r0,c0,r1,c1)=(min(r for r,c in ch),min(c for r,c in ch),max(r for r,c in ch),max(c for r,c in ch)) if ch else None
    print('=== demo',n,'bg',bg,'bbox',bb)
    for r,c in sorted(ch)[:25]:
        dr=1 if r>r1 else -1
        dc=1 if c>c1 else -1
        # dist to bbox right edge per row? use row-specific last shape col
        sr=max([cc for cc in range(w) if I[r,cc]!=bg],default=None)
        off=(c-sr) if sr is not None else None
        print(' ',(r,c),'off',off,'r+c',r+c,'parity', (r+c)%2)

import numpy as np, os, re, collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
feats=collections.defaultdict(list)
for n in range(1,7):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {n} output']); h,w=I.shape
    ch=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r,c]!=O[r,c]]
    shp=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if I[r,c]==min(set(I.flat)-{max(set(I.flat))})] if False else None
    cnt=collections.Counter(I.flat.tolist()); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    for r,c in ch:
        # distances to shape cells
        ds=min([abs(r-rs)+abs(c-cs) for rs,cs in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if I[rr,cc]!=bg]])
        cs=[rr for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if I[rr,cc]!=bg]
        # min chebyshev dist
        cd=min(max(abs(r-rs),abs(c-cs)) for rs,cc in [(rr,cc) for rr in range(h) for cc in range(w) if I[rr,cc]!=bg])
        # distance to nearest bg cell connected to shape? all bg here
        feats[(ds)].append((r,c,n,I[r,c]))
print('changed manhattan dist distribution:',sorted(feats.items())[:3])
print('count per dist:',{k:len(v) for k,v in sorted(feats.items())})

import numpy as np, os, re, collections
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
